# Spotify (6 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /artist | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get a Spotify artist |
| /track | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get a Spotify track |
| /album | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get a Spotify album |
| /search | `query` | 1 | Search Spotify |
| /podcast | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get a Spotify podcast |
| /podcast/episodes | `id` / `url` | 1 | List a Spotify podcast's episodes |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- *(none)* — no required parameters.

## Parameter Details

- `id` *(optional, string)*: Spotify artist ID.
- `url` *(optional, string)*: Spotify artist URL.
- `id (/track)` *(optional, string)*: Spotify track ID.
- `url (/track)` *(optional, string)*: Spotify track URL.
- `id (/album)` *(optional, string)*: Spotify album ID.
- `url (/album)` *(optional, string)*: Spotify album URL.
- `query`: Search query.
- `id (/podcast)` *(optional, string)*: Spotify podcast (show) ID.
- `url (/podcast)` *(optional, string)*: Spotify podcast (show) URL.
- `id (/podcast/episodes)` *(optional, string)*: Spotify podcast (show) ID.
- `url (/podcast/episodes)` *(optional, string)*: Spotify podcast (show) URL.
- `cursor` *(optional, integer)*: Cursor returned by the previous response. Omit for page 1.

## Example

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/artist?" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
